text: くろい　きりを　だして　せんとうに　でている　ポケモン　ぜんいんの　のうりょくの　へんかを　もとに　もどす。

structure.jp: くろい　きりを　だして
structure.en: puts out a black mist and

structure.jp: せんとうに　でている　ポケモン　ぜんいんの
structure.en: of all the Pokémon that are out in battle

structure.jp: のうりょくの　へんかを

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. くろい きりを だして = 'puts out a black mist and…'

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: せんとうに　でている　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing is meant, like English 'that…'. せんとうに でている ポケモン = 'the Pokémon that are out in battle'

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a state that is still going on: they came out and are still out. でている = 'are out'
